calibration.weighting: Each nonempty seed/scenario eligible stratum has total weight one; its groups have equal weights
calibration.quantile_definition: Weighted inverse empirical CDF at 0.90; no interpolation or quantile search
calibration.application: Replace the entire old uncertainty with q; release only if score + 0.5*q < 0 and the original pressure condition passes
calibration.assessment: Applying this q to its calibration OOF records is calibration-apparent, not independent verification
calibration.coverage: No 90-percent coverage guarantee; beta remains 0.5 and action groups within a seed are dependent

false_release_definition: Selected raw cost strictly exceeds GP cost among released non-reference actions; ties are reported separately
raw_policy_definition: Final argmin without confidence or pressure filtering; other guarded policies preserve the original pressure condition
inference: No confidence intervals from the single historical validation seed; OOF calibration-apparent results and historical8171 are not fresh independent confirmation
